stem: One zone shows faster dryback, rising root-zone EC, and lower measured emitter output while neighboring zones remain stable. Which integrated conclusion is strongest?
choices: The evidence supports a zone-specific delivery problem contributing to water and concentration stress
A facility-wide nutrient problem is proven
The sensors should all be ignored
The crop genetics are the only plausible cause
rationale: The converging spatial evidence—delivery, dryback, and EC—supports a localized irrigation-distribution hypothesis.
